currentParagraphText: “Is it fine to leave it like this?” the Sword Saint asked.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Is it fine to leave it like this?” the Sword Saint asked.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Why wouldn’t it be?” Dina asked. “Nature doesn’t care what the landscape looks like. It adapts. Besides, the barrier ensured no creatures lived there before we started fighting, and I’m sure now that it’s dispelled, beasts that will be nourished by our remnant energies and Records will flock to it.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Dina nodded as she also finally dispelled her staff. The Sword Saint took her cue to leave as he looked at the battlefield they had torn up nicely, the entire local area destroyed.
